plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Positron GAM carrier Ethernet switch. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, chassis temperature, fan speed, power supply state, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 20095).
name: Switch

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: CPU utilization of the Positron GAM switch over the past 10 seconds as a 0-100 percentage (GAM-SYSUTIL-MIB gamSysutilStatusCpuLoadAverage10sec scalar).

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Chassis temperature of each Positron GAM sensor in degrees Celsius (GAM-SYSUTIL-MIB TemperatureX10, divided by 10 at collection time). High temperatures can indicate cooling failure or airflow obstruction.

metrics.name: device_fan_speed
metrics.description: Fan rotation speed of the Positron GAM switch in RPM (GAM-SYSUTIL-MIB gamSysutilStatusFanRPM). Abnormally low or stalled fans risk overheating.

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: Power supply state of the Positron GAM switch (GAM-SYSUTIL-MIB gamSysutilStatusPowerSupplyState), normalized so that 1 = healthy (active or standby). Absent supplies are not emitted.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
